result.title: PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning
result.summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练框架 PSC-Gen，用一个 Physics Agent 迭代规划物理状态并核验生成的关键帧，再将关键帧插值成连续物理序列后仅注入其低频分量，引导视频扩散模型生成符合物理动态的视频。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属视频生成，并非 LVR 研究；但其「粗粒度动态作为条件注入、细节交由生成器」与「规划—核验—修正」循环，可能为 latent 轨迹的粗略监督与可验证状态更新提供概念线索，需进一步核查。
